title: Edit profile
description: As a logged-in user, I want to edit my personal information so that I can keep my profile up to date.
constraints: Required fields must be validated before saving.
The email address must follow a valid format.
A success message must be displayed after the update.
In case of a server error, the entered data must not be lost.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid form, when it is submitted, then the profile information is updated.
Given an invalid form, when it is submitted, then the validation errors are displayed.
Given a server error, when they submit the form, then an error message is displayed without clearing the form.
